privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: How AgriSahayak collects, uses, stores, and shares information.
privacy.introduction: This Privacy Policy explains how AgriSahayak handles information when you use the website and its agricultural tools. By using the service, you acknowledge the practices described below.
privacy.dataCollection: You may provide crop, soil, location, farm-planning, calculator, and feedback information. If you use disease detection, the image you select is uploaded to our backend for processing. The app does not require an account or collect a password.
privacy.localStorage: Language preferences, farm plans, cached data, diagnostics, and feedback that cannot be submitted are stored in your browser using local storage or IndexedDB. This information remains on your device unless you clear the app or browser data. Downloaded exports are saved wherever your browser stores downloads.
privacy.externalServices: Weather, news, market information, and disease detection may use third-party services configured for the deployment. Disease images may be forwarded to Kindwise Crop.health. Those providers may process information under their own privacy policies. Do not upload images or information you are not authorized to share.
privacy.feedback: When you submit feedback online, the message, language, submission time, and optional email address are sent to the configured Formspree endpoint so the app owner can receive it. Formspree may process and retain the submission under its own terms and privacy policy. An email address is optional and should only be provided if you want a response.
privacy.dataUse: Information is used to provide recommendations, calculations, weather and market displays, disease analysis, offline functionality, and responses to feedback. We do not use the app to create a server-side personal profile or sell personal information.
privacy.retention: Locally stored information can be removed through the Settings page's clear-cache action or your browser settings. Information sent to external providers is subject to their retention practices. Contact us if you need help identifying a deployment-specific data process.
privacy.security: We use reasonable application and hosting safeguards, but no internet transmission or browser storage is completely secure. Do not submit passwords, financial information, government identification numbers, or other sensitive personal information through the app.
privacy.choices: You can decline browser permissions, avoid optional email collection, clear locally stored data, and stop using any feature. Blocking cookies, scripts, or network requests may prevent some features from working.
privacy.contact: For privacy questions or requests, contact us at support@agrisahayak.example. Replace this placeholder with the operator's monitored address before publishing the application for production use.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: The rules and conditions for using AgriSahayak.
terms.introduction: These Terms of Service govern your use of AgriSahayak. By accessing or using the service, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, do not use the service.
terms.acceptance: You may use AgriSahayak only if you can legally agree to these terms. If you use it for an organization or farm business, you confirm that you have authority to accept these terms on its behalf.
terms.service: AgriSahayak provides agricultural information, crop and farm-planning tools, price calculations, weather and news displays, and optional disease-detection functionality. Features may change, be limited by configuration, or become unavailable without notice.
terms.advice: The service is an informational aid, not a substitute for advice from qualified agricultural officers, agronomists, veterinarians, financial professionals, or emergency services. Recommendations, prices, forecasts, disease results, and calculations may be incomplete, delayed, or inaccurate. Verify important decisions with reliable local sources and consider current field conditions.
terms.userContent: You remain responsible for images, feedback, email addresses, and other information you submit. You grant the app and its configured service providers permission to process that content only as needed to provide the selected feature. Do not submit content that is unlawful, infringing, harmful, or confidential without authorization.
terms.externalServices: The app may connect to services such as Formspree, Kindwise, weather providers, news feeds, hosting providers, and market-data sources. Their availability, accuracy, terms, and privacy practices are outside AgriSahayak's control. Your use of those integrations may be subject to their terms.
terms.prohibited: Do not misuse the service, attempt unauthorized access, interfere with its operation, bypass rate limits or security controls, upload malicious code, scrape data in a way that harms the service, or use outputs to make unlawful or dangerous decisions.
terms.availability: The service is provided on an as-available basis. Offline features depend on browser storage and cached data. We may modify, suspend, or discontinue features and may update these terms; continued use after an update means you accept the revised terms.
terms.liability: To the extent permitted by law, AgriSahayak is provided without warranties and we are not responsible for crop loss, business interruption, inaccurate information, provider outages, data loss, or decisions made using the service. Nothing here excludes liability that cannot legally be excluded.
terms.indemnity: To the extent permitted by law, you agree to protect the service operator from claims, losses, and expenses arising from your misuse of the service, violation of these terms, or infringement of another person's rights.
terms.changes: These terms are intended to be read together with the Privacy Policy. Before production launch, the operator should replace placeholder contact details and obtain legal advice on governing law, dispute resolution, consumer rights, and any local requirements.
terms.contact: Questions about these terms can be sent to support@agrisahayak.example. Replace this placeholder with the operator's monitored address before publishing the application.
